user.title: Chauffage
user.description: Weekly heating schedules for your thermostats. Edit them with the Chauffage card, change the heating mode with the mode entity.

import_package.title: Import from the package
import_package.description: The ha-chauffage package (v0.1) is installed. Its schedules ({thermostats} thermostats, {modes} modes), its current overrides and the active mode will be imported, and its two automations turned off so that only one scheduler drives your thermostats. You will then be told how to remove the package.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.
abort.package_too_new: The installed package saved its schedules in a newer format than this version of the integration understands. Update the integration first.

data_description.override_duration: How long a manual change lasts before the thermostat resumes its schedule.

levels.title: Heating levels
levels.description: Choose a level to change, or add one.

level.title: Heating level
level.description: The default temperature is used by thermostats that have no preset named like this level, or that are set to a temperature.

replace.title: Replace the level
replace.description: This level is used in schedules. Which level takes its place?

thermostats.title: Thermostats
thermostats.description: Choose a thermostat to set what each level means for it.

mapping.title: Levels of {thermostat}
mapping.description: For each level: automatic (the thermostat's preset named like the level, otherwise the level's default temperature), one of its presets, or a temperature (set in the field under it).

error.invalid_level: Invalid level: check the name, the color and the temperature.

abort.no_thermostats: No thermostat has a schedule yet: add one in the Chauffage card first.

package_installed.title: Remove the ha-chauffage package
package_installed.description: The Chauffage integration now schedules your thermostats; the package's automations have been turned off. To finish: delete `packages/chauffage/` and `www/chauffage/` from your configuration folder, remove the `/local/chauffage/chauffage-loader.js` line from `frontend: extra_module_url` and the three `sensor.*_chauffage` lines from `recorder: exclude` in `configuration.yaml`, then restart Home Assistant. In your own automations, replace `input_select.mode_chauffage` with `{mode_entity}`.

set_override.name: Set an override
set_override.description: Sets a scheduled thermostat's temperature or preset for a while, then it resumes its schedule (like a manual change).

entity_id.description: A thermostat that has a schedule.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Preset to use (or give a temperature).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long, in minutes (default: the integration's option).

end.name: End
end.description: When the override ends (instead of a duration).

clear_override.name: Clear an override
clear_override.description: Ends a thermostat's override now: it resumes its schedule.
